**Validation:** The search retrieved all 10 screened, build-discovered records (100% relative recall on that development set). There was no independent validation set, so this is not a sensitivity estimate. The optional psychological-theory block was left out: it reduced results by 59.8%, but the 10 known records were below the skill’s 15-record safety threshold for AND-ing. Its refreshed 30-record loss sample contained no eligible records, which does not establish that the block is safe to require.

The count exceeds the standard 10,000-record screening budget. The documented plan is for the review team to decide capacity; if retained, screen deduplicated title/abstract records in batches with two independent screeners and adjudicate disagreements. The scope is provisional: I assumed psychological explanatory accounts across depressive illness, rather than only intervention studies. The cutoff is the harness-required Entrez-date snapshot, not a publication-date limit.
